Protein floor (1.6 g/kg = ~161 g at 100.8 kg) cannot be verified. Energy availability is unknown. Under-fueling on a GLP-1 during a running comeback is the canonical lean-mass-loss and poor-recovery setup. Log every meal — even roughly — starting today.
